item_title.value: How do I create an account?

content.value: How do I create an account?
Click the "Sign Up" button in the top right corner and follow the registration process. You will be asked to confirm your email address before the account becomes active.

editor_settings.title: How do I create an account?

item_title.value: I forgot my password. What should I do?

content.value: I forgot my password. What should I do?
Click on "Forgot Password" on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your email. The reset link stays valid for one hour — request a new one if it expires before you get to it.

editor_settings.title: I forgot my password. What should I do?

item_title.value: How do I update my profile information?

content.value: How do I update my profile information?
Go to "My Account" settings and select "Edit Profile" to make changes. Most fields save straight away, but a new email address has to be confirmed from your inbox first.

editor_settings.title: How do I update my profile information?

item_title.value: Can I use the same account on more than one device?

content.value: Can I use the same account on more than one device?
Yes — sign in with the same email and password anywhere and your settings follow you. Every active session is listed under "My Account", so you can sign out of any you do not recognise.

editor_settings.title: Can I use the same account on more than one device?

item_title.value: How do I delete my account?

content.value: How do I delete my account?

Open "My Account" settings, scroll to the bottom and choose "Delete Account". You will be asked to confirm by email, and the account stays recoverable for thirty days before anything is removed for good.

editor_settings.title: How do I delete my account?
